LanguageData.CrystalTech_StartDropText: Something streaked across the night sky and thudded into the ground nearby. It was no ordinary meteor, but a translucent crystal pod, its cargo of trans-crystal material and mother-crystal shards scattered and still glowing.\n\nSomeone recognizes the crystal - the legendary trans-crystal said to let sunlight pour into every room. Perhaps it is worth researching.
LanguageData.CrystalTech_RewardTechText: The moment the research completed, every mother-crystal shard in the colony lit up and hummed in unison. A pod fell from the sky in answer - inside were sample weapons of trans-crystal: longsword, spear, greatbow, and a divine needle said to lock a body's meridians with a single strike.\n\nThe samples are ready to use. Mass production still requires smithing.
LanguageData.CrystalTech_RewardAdvancedText: Advanced crystal research is complete - the secrets of crystal lattice circuits and solar film are yours. The mother crystal hums again, and a pod delivers samples of the new technology: a crystal shield, goggles, and contact lenses.\n\nThe shield stops incoming arrows - while letting its wearer fire back through it.
LanguageData.CrystalTech_RewardReinforcedText: The final step of crystal reinforcement is done - the lattice densification process is perfected. The mother crystal gives one last, long hum, and a heavier pod lands with a full set of trans-crystal samples: weapons, shield, and every accessory.\n\nThe crystal source's final acknowledgment of a colony that has mastered trans-crystal.
LanguageData.CrystalTech_RewardTechOldSaveText: The crystal tech research archive has been reconciled. Sensing the colony's mastery, the mother-crystal shards call down a late-arriving pod with sample weapons: longsword, spear, greatbow, and the divine needle.
LanguageData.CrystalTech_RewardAdvancedOldSaveText: The advanced crystal research archive has been reconciled. The mother crystal hums, delivering samples of the new technology: crystal shield, goggles, and contact lenses.
LanguageData.CrystalTech_RewardReinforcedOldSaveText: The reinforced crystal research archive has been reconciled. With a final hum, a full set of trans-crystal samples lands - weapons, shield, and every accessory. The crystal source's final acknowledgment.
